meta.name: bpmn
meta.description: Create business process diagrams using PlantUML syntax with BPMN, EIP, and Lean Mapping stencil icons. Best for workflow automation, approval chains, message-based integration patterns, and value stream mapping.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 PlantUML 快速绘制业务流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码画 BPMN 或价值流图
copy.tagline_en: Draw business process diagrams quickly with PlantUML
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create BPMN or value stream diagrams with code

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成 BPMN 业务流程图、EIP 消息集成图或精益价值流图。你只需用文字说明流程，Claude 会输出 PlantUML 代码，渲染成带泳道、事件、网关和任务的图表。
howto.when: 当你要求绘制业务流程图、审批链、消息路由或价值流图时触发。例如说“画一个订单处理流程图”或“帮我设计一个审批工作流”。

say.text: 画一个订单审批流程图，包含开始、审批、结束。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 PlantUML 代码。

say.text: 用 EIP 图标画一个消息路由图，包含路由器和过滤器。
say.note: Claude 会使用 mxgraph.eip.* 图标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate BPMN business process diagrams, EIP message integration diagrams, or Lean value stream maps based on your description. You describe the flow in words, and Claude outputs PlantUML code that renders into diagrams with pools, lanes, events, gateways, and tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to draw a business process diagram, approval chain, message routing, or value stream map. For example, say "Draw an order processing flowchart" or "Design an approval workflow."

say_en.text: Draw an order approval flowchart with start, approval, and end.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the corresponding PlantUML code.

say_en.text: Draw a message routing diagram using EIP icons with router and filter.
